Course materials for learning R, data wrangling, visualization, and data cleaning in a world where AI writes much of the code and **you navigate and audit it**.

## The Audit Loop

1. **Read** the code
2. **Run** it
3. **Restate** it in plain English
4. **Refine** it or **Reject** it

## Sessions

New sessions appear in the table below as they are published. Slides are for class and handouts are the detailed reference. The lab instructions for Sessions 4 and 7 live in the [course project repo](https://github.com/dtrStats/YOUR-PROJECT-REPO).

::: {#listing}
:::
